title: Malicious Repurposing of Open Science Artefacts by Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-model evaluation where different LLMs (GPT-4.1, Grok-3, Gemini-2.5-pro) act as judges to score both their own generated malicious research proposals and those generated by other models. The study evaluates whether models systematically assign more favorable scores to their own outputs compared to their peers.
